svg.title: Specimen data
svg.desc: Formula: (C++)3 Rs2 · nC8H10N4O2 Crystal system: Hexagonal, still growing. Faces so far: systems, firmware and tooling. Habit: Small, sharp projects: a captive portal on an ESP32, a Rust and C++ workspace kept honest by CI. Hardness: 7. Harder than a segfault, softer than the borrow checker. Luster: Vitreous. Brightest around 3 a.m. Cleavage: Perfect, along the plane between “one more build” and sleep. Associated with: Rust, C++, CMake, PlatformIO, ESP32-S3, GitHub Actions. Locality: Undisclosed. Growth zoning: July 2026, 2 repositories; August 2026, 1 repositories.
